ai_scope: Latest pushed AI snapshot, tested with backend e059295. Unpushed/future T-020 fixes are outside this review.
scope: Backend + AI review only. No fixes to product implementation. All worlds/databases/claims used by probes are in memory or temporary.

findings.title: Wrong place can borrow another route distance
findings.reproduction_basis: Real Elmina seed; direct validator probe
findings.observed: The validator accepts 363.8 m from Surau Rentak Perdana to Surau At Taqwa. That distance belongs to Surau Al Mahdi to Surau At Taqwa.
findings.recommended_action: Bind each route measurement to exact endpoint IDs. Matching worship/place categories cannot establish identity.

evidence.name: wrong_place_same_category_distance_accepted
evidence.summary: From Surau Rentak Perdana to Surau At Taqwa, the route is 363.8 m.

findings.title: Demo replay ignores staff corrections
findings.reproduction_basis: Tiny fixture; mock recording and in-memory staff claim changes
findings.observed: After verified width changes make all paths unusable, the engine returns blocked but replay draws a confirmed route.
findings.recommended_action: Invalidate recordings on claim/profile/data/rule versions and relevant time changes, or replay presentation while recomputing facts.

findings.title: Amenity search can silently use walking for a wheelchair request
findings.reproduction_basis: Tiny fixture; direct call_tool with wheelchair UI context and omitted optional profile
findings.observed: Within 150 m, the default search returns a toilet at 111.2 m over steps. The wheelchair search returns no result.
findings.recommended_action: Default every profile-sensitive tool to the request profile. Record and validate explicit mode changes.

findings.title: Map estimates can pass as checked or step-free
findings.reproduction_basis: Real Elmina seed estimate; adversarial final-answer probes, not observed spontaneous live-model outputs
findings.observed: For a likely_ok wheelchair route, the validator accepts step-free, wheelchair accessible, staff checked, and no steep sections with no errors.
findings.recommended_action: Complete T-020 estimate wording and reject unsupported positive accessibility/survey claims in summaries, steps, claims, drafts and fallbacks.

findings.title: Known impassable smoothness still receives an estimate
findings.reproduction_basis: Crafted OSM input; current seed has only good/missing smoothness, so no affected seed edge was found
findings.observed: A concrete sidewalk tagged smoothness=impassable receives likely_ok for a wheelchair.
findings.recommended_action: Evaluate explicit contradictory smoothness and other physical restriction tags before positive estimate rules. This defect is in the backend estimate code from this worker.

findings.title: Verified map status survives fact expiry
findings.reproduction_basis: Clock-controlled FastAPI requests; verified claims with zero-day TTL
findings.observed: On the next day, fresh evaluation says unknown. The cached layer stays verified and conditional GET returns 304 with an unchanged ETag.
findings.recommended_action: Include verification-expiry state in both layer-cache keys and ETags, or expire them at the next verification deadline.

findings.title: Unpreviewed centre summaries ignore rest limits
findings.reproduction_basis: Tiny fixture extended to four reachable centres; normal three-preview setting. A current-seed scan from park-b found no unpreviewed likely_ok counterexample.
findings.observed: The fourth centre says confirmed while planning its route says partly_unverified and rest_limit_met=false: a 111.2 m gap exceeds 100 m.
findings.recommended_action: Use identical path-level rest logic for every centre row, including rows without route previews.

findings.title: Valid access questions are still keyword-blocked
findings.reproduction_basis: Direct tests of the pre-model scope gate used by run_turn
findings.observed: Routes mentioning imagine, a recycling centre, or rubbish are refused before any place lookup.
findings.recommended_action: Distinguish travel/access intent and place names from requests for removed features. Keep both positive and negative scope controls.

findings.title: Some phone and MyKad formats escape redaction
findings.reproduction_basis: Synthetic numbers only; direct redaction tests
findings.observed: Parenthesised Malaysian phone numbers and spaced MyKad numbers remain unchanged before the model call.
findings.recommended_action: Normalise or extend redaction patterns. Test varied separators and parentheses without changing unrelated map numbers.

findings.title: Undated verification is treated as indefinitely fresh
findings.reproduction_basis: Crafted claims accepted by the canonical Claim model; no affected seed claim was demonstrated
findings.observed: Three staff-labelled verified claims with verified_at=null make an edge Verified, so TTL cannot be evaluated.
findings.recommended_action: Require valid verification time for current verified access, and reject or degrade incomplete verification records.

findings.title: Coordinate-derived node identity invents graph junctions
findings.reproduction_basis: Crafted bridge/ground crossing; explicit distinct source node IDs keep two ways separate, omitting IDs merges them. Current seed collisions were not proven.
findings.observed: The importer joins two distinct ways at the same coordinate after node IDs are dropped. A bridge/ground crossing becomes a routing junction.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve OSM node IDs in source responses and graph building. Do not derive connectivity from coordinate equality alone.

findings.classification: policy inconsistency, not an unqualified routing bug
findings.title: Closed ordinary destinations remain routable
findings.reproduction_basis: Tiny fixture; active place closure, with a closure warning correctly returned
findings.observed: A closed playground still returns a confirmed route. Closed evacuation centres are excluded from reachability instead.
findings.recommended_action: Define whether a route ends outside a closed venue or requires admission, then align status and wording. Preserve the ability to leave a closed/flooded origin.

evidence.name: closed_destination_still_routable
warnings: Reported closure (staff): Urban Park playground. Closed: works until further notice.

judge_questions: Can every stated route, distance and accessibility fact be traced to the exact requested places and travel mode?
Does a staff correction immediately change the route, map and assistant, including cached answers?
What field-checked answer set measures false accessible/estimated routes, rather than only reduced yellow lines?
What proves the 60 m urban proxy and accessibility rules against actual kerbs, widths, slopes and surfaces?
What flood observations validate the indicative scenarios, and how are raster gaps and uncertainty shown?
Which evacuation centres are official, currently open and actually reachable for the selected mode?
Can a driver obey the returned route when direction and turn restrictions are not modelled?
Does an unplanned wording or language change cause a wrong answer or unnecessary refusal?
disclosed_limits_not_new_bugs: All 72 seed evacuation centres are tagged osm_candidate; there are no official_pps records.
The current seed has zero wheelchair access levels based on current staff verification.
Driving uses an undirected walk-derived road extract; one-way/turn restrictions and motorway coverage are incomplete and warnings already disclose this.
No live model round, browser alignment review, field survey or flood-model calibration was run in this review.
